checked_claims.assessment: The explicit base-Town-Hall analogy supports the narrow FAQ. No Carpenter movement, token return, construction, scenario setup, or other expansion procedure is imported. It does not establish the fate across rounds of a partially used Town Hall, and the FAQ does not claim that.

nonessential_verification_limits.detail: The BGG identifier and 90-minute duration in frontmatter are not established in the permitted rules pages. Editorial extraction/summary/verification dates and links are outside the game-rules verdict; no external sources were consulted.

source_handling_notes: The existing rendered base board/Place diagrams were inspected to verify printed costs, which are not fully represented in extracted prose.
Only the explicit Town Hall cross-reference on clarification p.3 and publisher/date credit on p.24 were used as evidence; other visible expansion material was excluded.
conclusion: No material or minor game-rule error or important in-scope omission found. All 10 base-board costs, all 20 base Place entries, original Bathhouse, timing, destinations, costs, exceptions, end conditions and scoring were checked. Narrow Town Hall FAQ is compatible with its permitted explicit publisher cross-reference.
